choke_points.title: CVE-2024-21887: Ivanti Connect Secure and Policy Secure Command Injection Vulnerability
choke_points.fix: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

choke_points.title: Agent identity has AdministratorAccess on the production AWS account
choke_points.fix: Replace AdministratorAccess with a least-privilege policy limited to the build pipeline's resources.

choke_points.title: Invoice Reconciliation Agent acts on external input with match_invoice (writes), update_vendor_bank (moves money), schedule_payment (moves money) and no human approval
choke_points.fix: Require human approval for write, payment and external-send tools, or split the agent so untrusted input cannot reach them.

choke_points.title: Customer Support Assistant acts on public input with update_customer (writes), send_email (sends outside) and no human approval
choke_points.fix: Require human approval for write, payment and external-send tools, or split the agent so untrusted input cannot reach them.

choke_points.title: Ops tools server answers MCP requests without authentication
choke_points.fix: Require authentication (OAuth 2.1 per the MCP authorization spec, or mTLS) and bind the server to a private interface.

choke_points.fix: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

findings.title: Invoice Reconciliation Agent acts on external input with match_invoice (writes), update_vendor_bank (moves money), schedule_payment (moves money) and no human approval
evidence: input: email_trigger (external)
tools callable without approval: match_invoice (writes), update_vendor_bank (moves money), schedule_payment (moves money)
findings.remediation: Require human approval for write, payment and external-send tools, or split the agent so untrusted input cannot reach them.

findings.title: Ops Automation Agent acts on internal input with run_shell (runs commands), aws_cli (admin), kubectl_apply (admin) and no human approval
evidence: input: Requests from any employee in the #ops-requests chat channel (internal)
tools callable without approval: run_shell (runs commands), aws_cli (admin), kubectl_apply (admin)
findings.remediation: Require human approval for write, payment and external-send tools, or split the agent so untrusted input cannot reach them.

findings.title: Customer Support Assistant acts on public input with update_customer (writes), send_email (sends outside) and no human approval
evidence: input: website_chat (public)
tools callable without approval: update_customer (writes), send_email (sends outside)
findings.remediation: Require human approval for write, payment and external-send tools, or split the agent so untrusted input cannot reach them.

findings.title: Invoice Reconciliation Agent keeps memory built from external input
evidence: memory: Vendor bank details and invoice history, kept between runs
findings.remediation: Do not let untrusted input write to long-term memory, or review memory changes before they are used.

findings.title: hr-helpdesk (aws_bedrock) is not in the AI inventory
evidence: cloud/aws_bedrock.json: agent 'hr-helpdesk' (Answers employee questions about HR policies in Microsoft Teams)

findings.title: support-kb indexes untrusted content: Customer ticket attachments
evidence: azure_ai_foundry export: source 'Customer ticket attachments' trust=external
findings.remediation: Keep untrusted uploads out of the index, or index them separately and mark them as untrusted for the agent.

findings.title: vendor-kb indexes untrusted content: Vendor onboarding emails
evidence: azure_ai_foundry export: source 'Vendor onboarding emails' trust=external
findings.remediation: Keep untrusted uploads out of the index, or index them separately and mark them as untrusted for the agent.

findings.title: hr-policies-kb answers from permissioned documents without checking the asker's access
evidence: aws_bedrock export: source permissions not enforced at retrieval
restricted documents in the index, e.g. 'Salary bands 2026'
findings.remediation: Turn on permission-aware retrieval so answers only use documents the asker can open.
